items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have mixed emotions about Bix. Naturally, he was a great, great cornet player... I have actually read some things where people say that Bix Beiderbecke influenced Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: The other name that creeps into – and this may be in the manner of correcting some things in the jazz literature that have creeped into discussions of trumpet players from St. Louis – is the influence of Bix Beiderbecke. What’s your thought on that?

I have mixed emotions about Bix. Naturally, he was a great, great cornet player, but as the history goes on, and the more I stay involved in the perpetuation of the craft of jazz and catch up and read up and read the [?] about jazz history and trumpet playing, people are – I have actually read some things where people say that Bix Beiderbecke influenced Louis Armstrong. This seems to be a general trend for history, and I know that’s not true. I just feel that it’s up to me to not allow fallacies of this sort to…
It’s not a – I don’t think in any by saying that, you’re putting down Beiderbecke.
